minutes.headline: PACC was told its studio has no place in the planned town hall annex, and the current building's boiler may fail this winter.
minutes.summary: A special PACC meeting heard the municipal building design committee's representative explain why the cable studio does not fit the planned new town hall, and that the current building's leaking boiler may not last the winter. PACC presented a reduced space plan and rough standalone-building costs. The representative agreed to send the floor plan to the architects and ask for standalone and add-on options. No formal votes were captured.

budget_items.topic: Previously approved capital funds for roof
budget_items.what_was_said: Funds approved earlier for replacing a roof section in the middle of the building are being considered for reprogramming to the front portion that would be preserved.
The leaking boiler needs an expensive repair or a replacement, and neither is in the budget.
A PACC member roughly guessed the cost of an empty standalone building to equip.
figures_as_heard: one and a half or two million

budget_items.what_was_said: An earlier study of a steel building like one in another town put the shell at a little over a million, with no money to run it. Another speaker cited a per-square-foot cost for a similar building.
figures_as_heard: just a little over a million

budget_items.topic: Cost of rehabilitating the old primary school
budget_items.what_was_said: Reusing the whole old primary school building was described as a price tag nearing a level the town would not accept.
The school committee has put out to bid a specialist to assess Turkey Hill building systems and has money ready for it.
The food pantry pays no rent. PACC was said to make a small transfer toward maintenance.
Some residents oppose tax dollars for studio space and want PACC's accumulated funds spent on any project.
The design committee has a self-imposed cap on the building project, with PACC seen as an add and a capital plan change adding more.

decisions.decision: The design committee representative will take PACC's floor plan, if emailed, to the architect and ask for standalone and add-on options for a PACC studio near the Ritter lot.
PACC members will not need to attend the design committee's meetings. They will be kept in the loop by the representative, who will ask the architects for alternatives.
The architects will work from the earlier 2300 square foot figure rather than the 2700 request, though PACC says its 1425 minimum is what it needs.

what_happened.line: The municipal building design committee's representative told PACC its cable studio does not fit the planned town hall annex, and the architects will work from the earlier, smaller space figure.
The representative said the leaking boiler in the current building needs an expensive repair or replacement, and neither is in the budget.
PACC presented a reduced space plan and a rough standalone-building option, and no vote was taken.
The representative will take PACC's floor plan, if emailed, to the architect and ask for standalone and add-on options near the Ritter lot.
PACC members will not need to attend the design committee's meetings; the representative will keep them informed.

why_it_matters: Where public-access TV and its studio end up is being decided inside a building project that has a self-imposed cost ceiling, so a studio could be priced as an add-on to a project residents may later be asked to fund.
The current building's boiler is an unbudgeted repair or replacement, which would be a cost the town has to cover from somewhere.
watch_next: The architects' response on standalone and add-on options for a PACC studio, once PACC emails its floor plan to the design committee representative.
Whether the school committee's building-systems study of Turkey Hill, now out to bid, reports back.
